flora: Flowering shrubs (multi-stemmed, bushy, covered in white blooms)
Coastal Tussock grass in the foreground
environment_details.style_notes: STYLE_ANIMATED_FEATURE_V3; rounded toy-like proportions; a sense of a 'new' kind of beauty in the Jurassic world; bright white flowers popping against dark green foliage.

visual_logic.composition: A sunny view of a coastal ridge. Low, bushy Magnoliid shrubs are in full bloom, their large white flowers acting as bright beacons. The ground is sandy with patches of seafoam-green moss. In the distance, the hazy blue of the lagoon is visible.
visual_logic.ground: Dry sandy soil mixed with crushed shell fragments and ochre siltstone.
visual_logic.lighting: Warm, hazy coastal sunlight that makes the white petals look almost luminescent.
